notes.title: 8/9/22 patch notes
notes.notes:
Save data was restored after the previous update.

[quote]If you are having issues with your save data, you may need to do the following:
[olist]
[*]Navigate to the save data folder:
 [Steam Install]/SteamApps/common/Senran Kagura Shinovi Versus/savedata
[*]Backup the files in this folder just in case
[*]If there are save files you need that have "_d" before the .dat file extension, please rename the file so it no longer ends in "_d"
For example:
"senran2_00_d.dat" will need to change to "senran2_00.dat"
[/olist][/quote]

notes.title: 8/8/22 patch notes
notes.notes: Players may now opt into cross-play with GOG when launching the game.

notes.title: 7/5/16 patch notes
notes.notes:
-Fixed various issues with visual effects for Secret Ninja Arts and thrust attacks 
-Fixed an issue in the Japanese settings with CGs #13 and #24
-Fixed an issue where blocking Homura's strong aerial attack caused her to dive perpetually (now she only dives for an uncomfortably long time...)
-Fixed an issue causing the TabTip.exe process to interfere with the game running properly

Finally, we added options to turn off cutscenes for clothing tearing, Ninja Arts, and Shinobi Transformations! They're located in the Video section of the Settings menu.

notes.title: IMPORTANT: Upcoming Update Details / 重要なニュース：近日配信予定のアップデート詳細
notes.notes:
We will be changing the executable name for Senran Kagura Shinovi Versus. It is currently named "Application.exe", and we will be changing it to "SKShinoviVersus.exe".

The current name is not descriptive, and may be confusing to players when managing PC resources. It may also cause conflicts with other services using the same executable name.

What this means for you:
-When the name is changed, there will be some downtime where the executable name that Steam is looking for and the one on your computer may not be synchronized. This will cause the game to be unable to launch. However, this window of time should be short.
-Anyone using third party services to alter the game should update the executable name if it is used in the settings (for example, GeDoSaTo).
-You may have to add "SKShinoviVersus.exe" as an exception to any firewalls if you had already done so with "Application.exe".

The following will also be updated:
-Mouse buttons may now be held down to properly charge attacks.
-Fixed a bug where some voices, such as Kiriya's, did not respond to in-game voice volume adjustment.

The update will go live at 3PM PDT Thursday 6/23 (7AM JST Friday 6/24). Please update the game promptly in order to avoid any issues.

---

次回のアップデート時に実行ファイルの名前が現在の「Application.exe」から「SKShinoviVersus.exe」に変更されます。

現在の実行ファイル名は見つけづらく、PC上でリソースを管理する際、多くのプレイヤーの方に混乱を招いていました。また、PC上に他の「Application.exe」という名前の実行ファイルが存在していた場合、プログラム上で2つのファイルが衝突してしまう可能性があった為、実行ファイル名を変更致します。

この変更に伴い、以下のことが考えられます。

・ファイル名が変更された時、これまでの実行ファイル名と新しい実行ファイル名が違うため、Steamアプリが新しいファイル名を認識するまでの間ゲームが起動できなくなりますが、この現象はすぐに解消される見込みです。

・MODなどサードパーティのソフトウェア内で実行ファイル名を指定していた場合、「SKShinoviVersus.exe」を新たに指定する必要があります。

・「Application.exe」をファイアウォールやセキュリティソフトの設定内で例外登録していた場合、「SKShinoviVersus.exe」にも同様の設定を行う必要があります。


上記のアップデートに併せて以下の修正も行われます。

・マウスのボタンを押し続けることによって、攻撃を溜めることができます。
・設定画面のボイス音量の数値が霧夜や他のキャラクターの音声に反映されない不具合を修正しました。


アップデートの配信日は日本時間6/24日（金）の午前7時頃を予定しております。

notes.title: 6/9/16 patch notes
notes.notes:
-Minor text and sound updates
-Fixed an issue where certain sound effects, like Yozakura’s gauntlets, were not responding to in-game volume adjustment
-Fixed an issue where in-game timers on timed missions were running at half speed
-Fixed an issue where DLC accessories could not be removed
-Fixed an issue where DLC lingerie would not be saved after being equipped in the dressing room
-Fixed an issue where keyboard and mouse shortcuts would be reset in multiplayer mode
